## TONGA — profile (page 228)

- **Header facts:** Region: East Asia & Pacific; Income group: Upper-middle-income; Lending category: IDA; Data status: Data as reported (A); Population: 104 thousand; GNI: 723.4; Unit: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** 164.1, **-5.5% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:** 184.3 in 2015 and 164.1 in 2025. The line falls from 2015 to 2016, rises in 2017, is roughly flat in 2018–19, rises again in 2020, reaches a peak around **2021** (≈ highest point of the series), then declines through 2022–24 and falls further to 2025.

- **Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:**
  - **Total external debt:** 164.1
  - **Public & publicly guaranteed (PPG):** 164.1
  - **Private nonguaranteed (PNG):** not shown
  - **Short-term:** not shown

  - **Public & publicly guaranteed — by creditor type:** 164.1
    - **Multilateral:** 111.5
    - **Bilateral:** 52.6

  - **Multilateral:** 111.5
    - **World Bank-IDA:** 42.6
    - **IMF-SDR allocations:** 27.1
    - **Other multilateral:** 41.7

  - **Bilateral:** 52.6
    - **China:** 52.6

- **Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25:**
  - **External debt / exports:** 83%, **-11.8%**. Trend: overall downward, with some mid-period fluctuation and a marked decline toward 2025.
  - **External debt / GNI:** 23%, **-9.3%**. Trend: generally declining, with a small bump around the middle of the period, then falling to 2025.
  - **Debt service / exports:** 11%, **-54.0%**. Trend: low and uneven for most years, rising sharply to a late spike around ≈2024, then dropping in 2025.
  - **Debt service / GNI:** 3%, **-52.7%**. Trend: low and fairly flat for much of the period, rising late to a spike around ≈2024, then declining in 2025.

  - **Private creditors:** Maturity **..**; Grace period **..**; Interest rate **..**

- **Note:** Figure 4 shows no data values for official or private creditors because the country did not have new commitments in 2025.
- **Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
